author: ojiudezue
title: v5.82.0 shipped: Two census features become device switches (Presence Face Matching, Name People at Doors), no-reload toggle + defaults ON
summary: Promotes face_recognition_enabled + egress_identity_enabled to device switches on the URA integration; toggling writes options WITHOUT reloading the parent entry (added to reload-suppress allowlist + SIGNAL_URA_FACE_RECOGNITION_CHANGED live-refreshes the boot-cached presence/transit consumers); egress is fresh-read. Defaults flipped ON (face_recognition new True, egress False->True) so both activate on deploy; switches are the live kill path. enhanced_census stays in options (structural). Tier 2-DB: 2 plan reviews + 3 framing-disjoint reviews + fix-up; mutation-verified behavioral tests. No new sensors.
